compared two accounts for twenty minutes and switched neither.
looked twice in a week during a quiet stretch. nothing happened.
cancelled a thing and immediately got an email offering a discount.
filed the receipts I'd been carrying around for a month.
updated the card details on one service and forgot the rest.
past about the third look in a week the number stops landing as money. it's a figure that moves, and I stop reacting to it moving.
then each look is an event. that's when it lands as money.
checked whether a refund had landed. it hadn't.
looked at last month's total and looked away again.
split a bill four ways and covered the rounding.
set a reminder for a renewal I'd forgotten about.
went a month without looking while nothing was moving.
bought the thing I'd had in a basket for three weeks.
worked out the annual cost of something and stopped there.
every stupid thing I've done with that account, I did after a long gap and one look. the stretches where I looked every day, I did nothing at all.
not one trade. I just watched it.
moved money between two of my own accounts for no clear reason.
checked the statement line by line for once.
said no to a group thing on cost grounds.
added something to a wishlist instead of buying it.
